messages:
Alex (CS): AureliaHealth onboarding note: token spend rose ~32% after adding narrative summarization. p95 tail spikes on >1k token reports. renewal in ~6w. want a conservative optimization plan.
Sora (AureliaHealth): clinicians call out subtle tone changes in discharge closing paragraphs after the change. Templates (medlist, discharge bullets) are consistent. Freeform diag text is sensitive.
Rina (Solutions): can you paste a short token histogram and a couple example prompts? helps build routing rules.
Sora (AureliaHealth): token mix: 58% <=128, 32% 129-1024, 10% >1024. example long prompt attached in ticket #9921.
Vik (Eng-ML): recommendation: 1) int8 quantized compact model for templated endpoints 2) header/prefix routing to compact 3) uncertainty scoring -> fallback to full model 4) KV prefix cache for repeat templates. minimal change to client.
Luis (SRE): ops note: caching + batching reduces tail but we must verify cache TTL meets PHI policy. also need endpoint exclude list for audited calls.
Alex (CS): propose we use a header approach so routing is deterministic: clients add X-Aurelia-Template. less brittle than NLP routing.
Sora (AureliaHealth): we can add that header server-side. estimate 2 dev days. we'll also flag audited endpoints.
Rina (Solutions): draft canary config (minimal, can expand):
```
shadow: 48h
rollout_steps: [5, 20]
compact_model: compact-int8-2026
full_model: full-2026
route_on_header: X-Aurelia-Template
exclude_paths: [/compliance/*]
quant_profile: int8-safe
```
Vik (Eng-ML): also plan an eval: 50 golden discharge notes, ROUGE + clinical QA checks, plus an uncertainty threshold to trigger fallback. I'll build the harness.
Alex (CS): action for renewal deck: cost delta, quality regression checks, rollback criteria. need clear thresholds for rollback.
Sora (AureliaHealth): rollback criteria: quality drop >1.5% on clinical QA OR p99 >4s. we also want notification before any auto-rollback.
Luis (SRE): rollout-bot, schedule shadow 48h, then 5% for 6h, then 20% if stable. enable alerts on p95/p99 and error rate; auto-rollback thresholds as specified.
rollout-bot: scheduled canary: shadow=48h -> staged rollout 5% then 20%; auto-rollback thresholds set. link: https://console.redwood.internal/canaries/3488881234
Rina (Solutions): one refinement: prefix-based routing for templates plus header for extra safety. keep an NLP fallback to detect templates if headers missing.
Vik (Eng-ML): agreed. NLP fallback should be shadowed only, not used for routing until validated.
Alex (CS): tasks: 1) Sora to add X-Aurelia-Template header + mark audited endpoints 2) Vik to prepare eval harness 3) Rina to finalize canary + exclude list 4) Luis to run canary and alerts 5) Alex to update renewal deck.
Sora (AureliaHealth): confirmed. will add header and send PR ETA 2 days.
Vik (Eng-ML): will deliver eval results within 72h of shadowing start.
Luis (SRE): will monitor and post p95/p99 + cost delta in this thread during the canary.
Alex (CS): thanks all. I'll circle back with the initial shadow metrics and the renewal slide update. :thumbsup:
Sora (AureliaHealth): thank you, appreciate the cautious approach.
Rina (Solutions): noting follow-ups for the enablement session to train client devs on header usage.
